netlist:
C Cin VIN1 n1
L Lg n1 n2
NMOS M1 n4 n2 n3 VSS
L Ls n3 VSS
R Rfb n4 n2
L Ld VDD n4
L Lsrc n3 n5
C Ct1 n4 n5
C Ct2 n5 VSS
C Cout n5 VOUT1
rationale: The proposed topology improves the binding constraints—particularly NF and S21—by introducing a source-degenerated common-source stage with inductive peaking, which enhances gain and noise performance without increasing power. The addition of an inductor in the source path (Lsrc) provides impedance matching and resonant gain boost at 1.575 GHz, while the feedback resistor (Rfb) stabilizes gain and improves input matching. The modified topology maintains low current draw and ensures sufficient stability margin, addressing the negative margins in both NF and S21 without violating other constraints.
